title: Remove and reseal the right engine cover
completeness: Complete bounded bench operation from the declared entry state to the declared exit state. Whole-bike access and downstream engine closure are separate dependencies.

source.review_note: All cited operation pages visually reviewed. General symbols and conditional torque rules retained.

applicability.included: Exact US2026 YZ450F standard stock components only
excluded: Final oil fill and engine commissioning

required_tools.name: Parallel seal driver and circlip tools

required_parts.name: New internal oil seal/circlip if renewed

preflight: Engine out, fluids drained, clutch cover removed, external hoses clear.
entry_state: Engine out, fluids drained, clutch cover removed, external hoses clear.
exit_state: Right cover/filter/filler sealed; clutch cover and fluid commissioning remain.
critical_stop_conditions: Any required measurement unresolved or replacement criteria not satisfied.
Unidentified diagram orientation, missing parts, damage or abnormal binding.

material_policy.LT: Locking agent (LOCTITE) per PDF7. Grade unspecified by this manual; no grade inferred.
material_policy.lubrication: Follow each explicit E/M/LS/S application; general dry torque does not override a lubricated joint.

steps.title: Confirm right-cover access
steps.instruction: Start with a supported removed engine, oil and coolant drained, clutch cover removed, and hoses/hardware clear of the right cover. Preserve the installed water pump until its separate bench operation is selected.
verification: Drained engine and clutch-cover access confirmed.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Remove the right cover
steps.instruction: Remove oil-filter-element cover and element, then filler cap. Map the right-cover bolt lengths/locations from the diagram, remove the bolts and lift away the case cover. Retain the two dowels, discard the gasket, and keep the cover sealing parts identified.
verification: Cover, element, filler and two dowels retained.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Record any cover service needed
steps.instruction: Inspect the removed cover and its sealing parts. The separate water-pump operation begins with this cover on the bench. If renewing the illustrated internal oil seal, remove its circlip/old seal and retain the check-ball seat at its shown position; replace the seal and circlip.
verification: Cover service performed or not needed recorded.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Install the cover oil seal if renewed
steps.instruction: For a renewed internal seal, grease its lip with lithium-soap grease and press it parallel at0mm depth with its manufacturer marks/numbers facing inward. Install the new circlip and restore the illustrated check-ball seat. If untouched, record that the original arrangement remains installed.
verification: Seal0mm/inward marks and new clip recorded, or intact original arrangement.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Refit the right cover
steps.instruction: After required primary/oil-pump/shift work is complete, fit both dowels and a new right-cover gasket. Seat the cover and tighten its bolts progressively in a crisscross pattern to10Nm at their original locations. Do not use bolts to pull a binding pump drive into place.
verification: Two dowels, new gasket and10Nm cover bolts verified.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Restore oil filter and filler
steps.instruction: Install the exact filter element in its original direction and its cover with a new O-ring lubricated with lithium-soap grease; tighten cover bolts10Nm. Fit filler cap with its new O-ring lubricated with lithium-soap grease. Oil filling and level checks belong to final engine commissioning.
verification: Filter direction, new O-rings and10Nm cover closure recorded.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

runtime_integration_requirement: Enforce entry state and record_required. Completion certifies this bounded operation only; no automatic completion of upstream/downstream work.
